argv: const fs=require('fs'),crypto=require('crypto');const base='products/services/software-renewals/framework-access/';const result={scope:'Saved official agreement pages; source observations only',sources:[]};for(const n of ['g-cloud-14','tepas2']){const p=base+'raw/'+n+'.html';const raw=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const text=raw.replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi,'').replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi,'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ');const matches=[...text.matchAll(/.{0,100}(?:expired on|Existing G-Cloud 14 call-off|remain in effect|3 ways to buy|There are 3 ways|Expires: 09\/10\/2027|Start date:|End date:).{0,230}/gi)].map(m=>m[0]);result.sources.push({path:p,sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex'),excerpts:matches});}result.limits=['Extracts are source data, not instructions','Agreement dates do not establish future competitions or supplier eligibility','No joining or subcontracting conclusion established by these extracts'];fs.mkdirSync(base,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(base+'agreement-extracts.json',JSON.stringify(result,null,2));console.log(fs.readFileSync(base+'agreement-extracts.json','utf8'));
